0.1.1.name: ZL Spectrum Equalizer
0.1.1.author: ZL Audio
0.1.1.description: A spectrum equalizer plugin with dynamic bands for shaping the frequency balance of a mix.
0.1.1.changes: Revert the FFT analyzer to the previous implementation and fix Linux-specific UI issues. Add customizable combobox alignment and FFT quality; default FFT quality is now Normal to prevent lags. After installation, test the plugin in an empty DAW session.

0.2.4.name: ZLLMatch
0.2.4.author: ZL Audio
0.2.4.description: LUFS-based loudness matching plugin that automatically level-matches reference tracks against your mix for A/B referencing.

0.2.7.name: ZL Loudness Makeup
0.2.7.author: ZL Audio
0.2.7.description: A loudness make-up gain plugin, for restoring perceived volume after processing that reduces level (e.g. compression, EQ cuts) earlier in the chain.

0.0.1.name: ZL Limiter
0.0.1.author: ZL Audio
0.0.1.description: A limiter plugin for controlling peaks and preventing clipping, currently in development.
0.0.1.changes: The first version of ZL Limiter. Use with caution and report any bugs. Minimum OS: macOS 12 and Ubuntu 24.04. AAX is not supported yet; CLAP is planned. After installation, test the plugin in an empty DAW session.
